$comment: HERD1's budget, as android-compat.yml's storm scenario checks it (check-budget.mjs) over every request home hears in the whole run, all routes and pulls together: in any window of T ms, at most burst + ceil(T / sustainedMs) requests; after a 429, none until its Retry-After has passed (pairing and sign-out excepted), then at most one per sustainedMs for pacedForMs. Per pull, HERD1 promises structure, not a count (one pull may reach the burst): two pulls 1 s apart must cost home no more than one alone, which storm.sh checks as its 'joined' phase. From HERD1, PR #3110 (apps/www/src/lib/home-link/__tests__/herd.test.ts); re-read it there when it lands.
